reuse.why: Reuses the shared schedules module and the existing getApproxNumberThreshold tolerance helper and replaces every inline midpoint copy with one getExpectedAmount; getScheduledAmount is kept as a parallel helper rather than built on the new one.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint/missing-amount copies; the remaining overlap is getScheduledAmount and getExpectedAmount both handling the number/range dispatch.

placement.why: The expected-amount rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the API field is added in the api-models mapper, matching where the tree keeps such logic.

scope.why: Edits are confined to schedule amount resolution, the API model and tests/release notes; comments in some call sites still describe the superseded 'furthest from zero' rule.

maintainability.why: One function now decides the expected amount everywhere, though two similarly named helpers and a redundant op ternary in schedule-template invite confusion.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All posting/preview/forecast/budget/API paths call getExpectedAmount; schedule-template wraps it in its own op check but still uses it.

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts) keeps its own number/range dispatch next to getExpectedAmount, but it delegates the range rule to getWorstCaseAmount rather than copying it.

abstraction_drift.where: getExpectedAmount takes an op parameter for the approximate case; schedule-template.ts keeps its own isbetween/isapprox ternary deciding when to call it.
